verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state AI Gateway automatically retries requests to other providers on failure, retries BYOK queries with system credentials on failure, supports per-provider timeouts for fast failover, and lets engineers control provider order/sort for failover policies. This directly satisfies automatic retry handling for transient provider errors. Missing for 10: explicit configuration of retry count/backoff parameters, and independent/hands-on verification of retry behavior in production.
